description: Hand-written questions for the Your Europe corpus (youreurope_handbook.json, 264 chunks). Gold written before any retrieval run. 'gold' = passage ids for the retrieval script; 'gold_chunks' = the same chunks as notebook ids; an empty list means the documents do not answer the question.

queries.query: My train got in 90 minutes late. What share of my fare can I claim?
queries.gold_answer: 25% of the ticket price, because the delay is between 1 and 2 hours (50% from 2 hours).
queries.note: fare/late vs ticket price/delay; rail.txt#36 (missed connection) has the same percentages and is a distractor

queries.query: Does my phone bill go up when I call home during a trip elsewhere in the EU?
queries.gold_answer: No. Calls, texts and data in another EU country are charged at domestic rates ('roam like at home').
queries.note: phone bill / call home vs roaming / domestic rates

queries.query: I hurt myself skiing and had to be brought down the mountain. Will my EU health card pay for that?
queries.gold_answer: No. The EHIC does not cover rescue or repatriation; you need separate insurance.
queries.note: brought down the mountain vs rescue; the sample story about Sven also answers it

queries.query: How much compensation for arriving 4 hours late on a 1 200 km flight?
queries.gold_answer: 250 EUR (flights of 1 500 km or less, delay at arrival of 3 hours or more).
queries.note: numbers decide it; the denied-boarding table (air.txt#24) and re-routing tables (air.txt#29, #33) are distractors

queries.query: Is the EUR 3 customs duty charged per parcel or per item?
queries.gold_answer: Per item (a 'goods item' with the same commodity code and origin), not per parcel; it applies to orders up to EUR 150 from outside the EU.

queries.query: Can I cancel a concert ticket I bought online within 14 days?
queries.gold_answer: No. The 14-day cooling-off period does not apply to concert tickets.
queries.note: returns.txt#1 describes the 14-day right in general and is a distractor; the exception decides it

queries.query: How long do I have to complain to a coach company?
queries.gold_answer: Within 3 months of the scheduled service; the company must react within 1 month and give a final reply within 3 months.
queries.note: rail.txt#6 also says 3 months for trains; air.txt#23 has 7/21 days for luggage

queries.query: Can I get my money back if my trip is cancelled?
queries.gold_answer: It depends on the type of trip. Flight: choice of reimbursement, re-routing or return. Train (arriving over 60 minutes late): refund within 30 days or re-routing. Long-distance bus: reimbursement within 14 days or re-routing. Package cancelled by the organiser: refund and, where appropriate, compensation. A good answer names the cases or asks which type of trip.
queries.note: trip type not stated; with k = 3 at most three of the four gold chunks can be retrieved

queries.query: What are my rights if my ferry is cancelled?
queries.note: the ship passenger page was deliberately left out; roaming.txt#25 mentions ships and bus/rail cancellation chunks look relevant

queries.query: Do I get compensation if my taxi to the airport is late?
queries.note: taxis are not covered; air delay and compensation chunks are distractors

queries.query: How much alcohol can I bring back tax-free from another EU country?
queries.note: not in the corpus; the EUR 3 customs duty chunks are distractors
